name: How should I document property damage from a car accident?

mainEntity.name: How should I document property damage from a car accident?

acceptedAnswer.text: Take clear photos, videos, and written descriptions of all damage immediately. Keep repair receipts and police reports to support your property damage claim.hamparyan+1​
